answer: The jade register is checked at draw time, glacier lists the eligible set, and knoll seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 56 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 56 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker burns for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 18 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
